description: Eleven strict Agent Skills: the Zhanggui selective-hybrid orchestrator, eight dual-mode engineering leaves, and the standalone setup-collaboration-files and decision-notes collaboration pair.

interface.shortDescription: One selective-hybrid root, eight dual-mode leaves, two standalone bootstraps
interface.longDescription: Eleven strict Agent Skills: one selective-hybrid stateful Zhanggui orchestrator with automatic or manual loading, eight zhanggui-* leaves with Direct and Zhanggui Embedded contracts, and the standalone setup-collaboration-files bootstrap paired with the decision-notes lifecycle. The root owns WorkflowState and activates leaves by SkillRequest; narrow requests stay with their corresponding leaf.
defaultPrompt: 复杂、跨模块或端到端工作可直接描述，由宿主自动匹配 Zhanggui；也可使用宿主原生命令手动进入。
Describe a complex end-to-end goal to automatically match Zhanggui, or describe a narrow task to match its engineering leaf.
